launch_count_derivation: launches = sum over batch EVENTS of ceil(local_views / batch).  An event is one _effective_view_batch call, made ONCE per sparse_forward_project_view_range call (projectors.py:382); that call then loops for v in range(v0, v1, vb_size) (projectors.py:386).  The assumption: each owner walks ONE contiguous real-view span (projectors.py:367-368, tomography_model.py:417-418), whose length is local_views_per_device.
